name: LeechBlock NG
title: LeechBlock NG: free Freedom alternative
hook: Freedom charges you about forty bucks a year to block distracting websites. This app does it for free.

features.intro: It blocks the sites that eat your day.
features.say: Block sites at set times, or after a time limit.
Lockdown blocks them right now, for as long as you choose.
Add a password or a delay, so you can't cheat.

install: Download from your browser's add-on store
install_line: It runs in Firefox and Chrome. Add it free from the store.
caption:
Freedom Premium charges about $40/year. LeechBlock NG blocks your time-wasting sites for free 🚫

✅ Block sites at set times or after a time limit
✅ Lockdown mode blocks them right now
✅ Password or countdown delay so you can't cheat
✅ No subscription, no sign up, 100% free

💻 Firefox · Chrome
ℹ️ Browser-only: it won't block phone apps or other browsers. Freedom's price is Premium yearly at $3.33/month

Comment "FOCUS" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
